name: pauli-speaks-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck buttons for Pauli Speaks: toggle, start, stop and cancel dictation, paste the last text.
author: Patrik Pauli

scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.pauli.speaks.streamdeck.sdPlugin --output dist --force --no-update-check
scripts.link: npm run build && streamdeck link com.pauli.speaks.streamdeck.sdPlugin
